boundary: Real kernel, DT instances, I2C emulator, GPIO emulator with ISR edges, work queues, input queue and thread, PM device actions and the ZMK listener. The sensor is a model: no capacitive front end, gesture classifier, electrical bus or measured timing.

cases.boot_fresh: Fresh part: every settings block once and in order, then ACK, ATI and event mode; tap gestures and resolution programmed; no forced reset; no reports; gesture/trackpad event sources on, Comms End Cmd off, ATI completion actually read
cases.boot_silent_event_mode: Part that kept power in event mode: forced reset at 200 ms with the exact command, then full setup; a tap reports afterwards
cases.boot_silent_suspended: Part that kept power suspended: the forced reset wakes it and setup completes
cases.boot_absent: No part: three forced resets at least 200 ms apart, then the bus stays quiet
cases.boot_wrong_product: Another product: one read, device disabled, bus left alone while RDY keeps streaming
cases.boot_bus_errors: Failed product reads retry through the RDY level; a failed settings block restarts the settings
cases.boot_reset_lost: A reset the part never acts on is issued again
cases.contact_abs: Absolute contact: edge, coordinates with sync on Y, filter on the real path, release with its last coordinate
cases.contact_rel: Relative contact: first-frame sync, averaged deltas, no contact edge; real listener sends five HID reports with X 0, 0, 46, 46, 0, Y 0 and no buttons
cases.contact_invalid: Invalid samples start no contact; once started they hold the last coordinate instead of lifting
cases.contact_second: A new contact reseeds the filter
cases.rotate_90: Rotation 90 for the contact and its release
cases.rotate_180: Rotation 180 for the contact and its release
cases.rotate_270: Rotation 270 for the contact and its release
cases.verify_holds_contact: A stationary finger with no RDY is read each 120 ms and stays down; the chain ends with the contact
cases.verify_finds_lift: A lift no RDY announced is released exactly once at the next verification
cases.verify_bus_failure: A failed verification read releases the contact; the next report starts a new one
cases.tap_triple_lift: Triple tap at lift: first press within 1 ms of gesture report read, six ordered synced edges at least 20 ms apart
cases.tap_triple_after_contact: Contact, then triple tap at its lift: contact reports first
cases.tap_triple_during_touch: Triple tap during a contact: clicks keep their pace across the lift
cases.tap_relative_mode: Triple tap in relative mode, no contact edge
cases.tap_button_map: Single, double and triple taps on devicetree buttons 1, 2 and 3: exact input edges and twelve real-listener HID reports with matching button masks and zero motion
cases.tap_disabled: Explicit and omitted disabled cells emit no click; contacts still report
cases.tap_priority: All tap flags in one frame: triple only
cases.tap_other_gestures: Palm and swipe flags emit nothing
cases.tap_replaces_at_press: A new tap while pressed releases the old button first, then plays
cases.tap_replaces_at_release: A new tap between clicks drops the rest with no extra release
cases.rdy_level_recheck: RDY left active after a read is found by the level recheck within milliseconds
cases.rdy_stuck: Stuck RDY: four fast recoveries, then 20 ms back-off, no reports; recovery state clears after release
cases.rdy_no_change: RDY with nothing new reports nothing
cases.report_read_retry: NACKed report read retries in 1–4 ms through the still-active RDY level, before any window timeout or new event
cases.input_backpressure: Independent 110-ms sensor cadence: exactly 17 accepted events stall on ninth contact read; three 100-ms windows lost at sensor, all 19 produced contact reports delivered in order after resume, followed by fresh lift/triple tap
cases.reset_idle: Runtime reset: settings, ACK, ATI and event mode again; taps afterwards
cases.reset_at_press: Runtime reset while pressed: the owed release only, no later presses
cases.reset_at_release: Runtime reset between clicks: no extra release, no later presses
cases.reset_touching: Runtime reset during a contact: released, verification ended, new contact works
cases.pm_idle: Suspend and resume through PM device actions: exact commands, edges ignored, setup retained
cases.pm_at_press: Suspend while pressed: release delivered before it returns, no replay after resume
cases.pm_at_release: Suspend between clicks: no extra release, no replay
cases.pm_touching: Suspend during a contact: released, verification cancelled, new contact after resume
cases.pm_bus_down_at_suspend: Dead bus at suspend still succeeds and quiesces; resume writes nothing
cases.pm_bus_down_at_resume: Dead bus at resume: wake retried fast, then at 1000 ms, and recovered
cases.pm_during_setup: Suspend during setup: resume starts over and completes
cases.pm_early_device: Early device suspends every sensor before their own turn; no second write
cases.two_sensors_independent: Independent exact streams: sensor A triple click; sensor B mapped triple click, contact XY, 120-ms verification XY, and lift with last coordinate
cases.two_sensors_suspend_one: Suspending one sensor leaves the other playing
cases.hid_triple_tap: Real listener: triple tap is six HID reports toggling the left button
cases.hid_abs_contact_is_left_button: Real listener with no processors: the absolute contact edge is the left button, which a production route must drop
cases.input_backpressure_verify_contact: Stationary verified contact fills 17 input slots; ninth packet blocks, one later window expires and verification becomes queued during the stall. After resume, forced verification still reports contact with exactly 21 reports and no release; normal lift makes 24.

finish: 300-ms settle: no new reports; balanced keys/contacts; present sensors have no contact/release/verification/click work pending and quiet bus. Absent sensors only their at most three boot-reset attempts.
